source.spec: YNAB API spec 1.88.0 (api.ynab.com/papi/open_api_spec.yaml): ErrorResponse {error: {id, name, detail}}, server_knowledge on every list
source.built: by hand from the spec, not recorded (YNAB can't be recorded live); invented ids

fixtures.description: A read YNAB rate-limits once (429, no Retry-After: YNAB documents none), then answers: GET /categories twice.
A read YNAB rate-limits on every try: GET /accounts three times, 429 each time.
A transaction POST YNAB rate-limits (rejected before it runs), then creates: POST /transactions twice.
A transaction POST answered 503: it may have run, so it is not sent again.

Two full transaction reads around a server_knowledge reset (a budget restored in YNAB): the second answer's server_knowledge (7) is below the first's (1204) and holds only what the restored budget has.
Writes to a category deleted in YNAB: the category read and the month's budgeted PATCH answer 404 resource_not_found.
